description: In a crowded street market in an Asian city in late afternoon light, a young woman with long blonde hair, a loose white shirt, beige trousers and sandals stands with a wheeled suitcase and an open guidebook. She looks up and around at the signs in a foreign script, then down at her book and around again as a motor scooter passes behind her. A stallholder hands a paper bag across a food cart, and paper lanterns, cycle rickshaws and tangled overhead cables fill the busy street.
